name: Oerlinghausen (Germany)
description: Horizontal tricolour of yellow, white and red, charged at the centre with the city arms of Oerlinghausen (a white glider above a rose on yellow, on red).
history: By deed of the Regierungspräsident in Detmold of 18 April 1978 the city of Oerlinghausen was granted the right to bear arms, a flag, a banner and an official seal; the hoisted flag and the banner are yellow, white and red striped.

features.role: Oerlinghausen arms — glider and rose on red
